items.slide_topic: capabilities: how the 18-hour film was made (third-party description)
items.dek:
Claude just generated and directed a full Windows XP music video overnight.

The creator, @anabology on X, made it to mark Windows XP turning 25 on October 25. He ran Claude Opus 5.5 inside Claude Code and let it handle almost the whole process. Claude wrote the lyrics, planned the storyboard and created the prompts. Suno generated the song. Midjourney made the visual assets, while Seedance 2.5 generated many of the video clips. For this version, he also let Claude use Midjourney video and told it to imagine the whole music video was being recorded from a Windows XP desktop. Claude then wrote the code used to place the Windows UI, lyrics and other graphics over the footage, sync everything to the music and assemble the final video. He said he did not write the lyrics or review the storyboard. He gave Claude the setup, left it running for around 18 hours, and came back to this.

facts.claim: On Oct 2, 2026 X user @anabology posted 'I gave Claude another 18 hours.. and I think this one is the best one yet - Macrohard: Windows XP - I'm blown away'; the 3-minute film had 1.48M views and 14.3K likes within two days.

The 18 hours is creator-reported wall-clock time he 'gave' Claude. It follows two 12-hour runs: 'Gave Opus 5.5 donald's prompt, Midjourney, and a moodboard / 12 hours later, woke up to this' (Sep 25, 19.6M views) and 'Gave Claude another 12 hours to one up this.. Woke up to.. The Clodyssey' (Sep 30).

Reported by evolving.ai (not confirmed by the creator in anything loaded): he ran Claude Opus 5.5 inside Claude Code; Claude wrote the lyrics, storyboard and prompts; Suno made the song; Midjourney (images and video) and Seedance 2.5 made the footage; Claude wrote the code that overlaid the Windows UI and assembled the video.

In the film, the login screen says 'Agents now have their own user accounts.'; the AI user 'Claudia' goes from '14 programs running' to '100 programs running'; Task Manager fails to kill it ('claudia.exe is busy dancing.').
facts.source: video frames at 1 s, 136.5 s, 156.6 s

facts.claim: In the film, a code window reads 'async def accept_all(diff): # TODO: read this later; await diff.apply(force=True); # You used to read the code.' followed by a Confirm File Replace dialog: 'yours: 2 KB, written by you ... mine: 4,096 KB, written by Claudia, just now. Don't ask me again. I 'Accept All' always.' (satire of unreviewed AI code)

Anthropic's Felix Rieseberg on the 18-hour film: 'As far as Claude music videos go, this is by far my favorite one yet. I prefer Claude being a tool used by humans to make art rather than making art unattended, but even so, I really enjoyed this one. Probably because it's a little meta.' (personal opinion)

The first film in the series (12 hours, Opus 5.5 + Midjourney + a moodboard, driven by donald's prompt) drew 19.6M views and a public reaction from Elon Musk, who wrote he 'really felt the AGI profoundly this time' (2026-09-28).
Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5) was released by Anthropic on 2026-09-22, the first model of the Claude 5.5 family.
